emotional_archetype: High-Stakes Wall Street Competition, Institutional Trading Floor, Tactical Precision
inspiration_references: The Big Short (cinematic high contrast, intense typography)
Margin Call (dark midnight office, sleek financial terminal)
Scam 1992 (bold numbers, tension, gold & ticker aesthetics)
Bloomberg Terminal / TradingView Dark Mode UI

typography.headline_font: Instrument Serif, Playfair Display, Georgia, serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.mono_display_stat: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-mono tracking-tighter font-bold

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Tactical Density with Generous breathing room between structural sections. 1px precise borders, zero bulky shadows.

visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: Subtle grain CSS overlay on hero and dark panels
visual_enhancers.ticker_marquee: Continuous financial ticker crawl at header top with live crypto/forex/stock pairs
visual_enhancers.candlestick_motif: SVG backdrop grid with glowing bullish green & bearish red candles
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Terminal green & amber subtle inner drop-shadows on active states
visual_enhancers.card_chrome: 1px solid #212A3E stroke with corner ticks (+) for high-tech institutional look

hero_section.headline: THE MARKET DOESN'T FORGIVE.
hero_section.subheadline: Think fast. Trade smart. Manage risk.
hero_section.background: Dark vignette with semi-transparent candlestick chart canvas overlay (bg-black/40 overlay max)

round_cards.title: THE CALL
round_cards.details: Real-time chart pattern prediction: BUY / SELL / NO TRADE

round_cards.title: THE TRADE
round_cards.tagline: ONE HOUR. TWO TRADES. ONE CHANCE TO WIN.
round_cards.details: 1-Hour live simulation challenge with strict risk management & MAX 2 TRADES limit

participant_dashboard.header_stats: Team Name, Rank badge with gold border, Total Score, Current Round, Time Remaining in JetBrains Mono
participant_dashboard.round_cards_status: Status badges (LOCKED, IN PROGRESS, SUBMITTED, COMPLETED)

round_1_quiz.timer: Countdown bar with millisecond speed bonus calculation indicator
round_1_quiz.options: A/B/C/D radio cards with glowing hover borders and selected highlight

round_2_chart_prediction.chart_container: Full-width candlestick viewer (OHLC data, Volume bar sub-chart)

action_buttons.buy: Solid Profit Green button (#00E676) with upward candle icon
action_buttons.sell: Solid Loss Red button (#FF3B30) with downward candle icon
action_buttons.no_trade: Solid Amber button (#F59E0B) for capital preservation decision

round_3_trading.trade_counter: TRADES USED: X / 2 progress indicator banner
round_3_trading.trade_limit_state: Locked trading form with badge 'MAXIMUM TRADES REACHED' when 2 trades submitted

leaderboard.rank_change: Green arrow ↑ for position gain, Red arrow ↓ for drop, Grey dash — for stable
leaderboard.podium_top_3: Gold #1, Silver #2, Bronze #3 visual callout banners

sections: Question Management (CRUD for Round 1 & Round 2 charts)
Round 3 Trade Verification Queue (Pending, Verified, Rejected with Audit note)
Audit Log Stream & Announcement Broadcast System

final_podium_page.headline: THE MARKET HAS SPOKEN.
final_podium_page.layout: Projector-optimized 3D-styled 1st, 2nd, 3rd podium display with confetti particle effects & comprehensive breakdown table

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case data-testid attributes mandatory on all inputs, action buttons, table rows, round cards, modal controls, and tab triggers
testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: White text (#F8FAFC) on near-black (#07090E) exceeds 12:1 contrast ratio; green (#00E676) and red (#FF3B30) accompanied by readable icons/labels
testing_and_accessibility.motion_support: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS query for marquee ticker and numeric count-ups

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact dark cinematic color palette with #07090E background, #131824 panels, and JetBrains Mono / Instrument Serif typography.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Do not use transparent headers over hero images; use dark blurred backdrop blur.
Keep standard JS/JSX imports and React Router v7 structure compatible with the codebase.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for user interactions and trade verifications.
